maintenanceAssessment: Immutable successor to maui-identity-inventory-r2.json for AND.01 (identity-only correction, 2026-10-08). r2 recorded eng/policy/licence-boundary.json as changed (sha256 5a9f7ecd...), adding the .NET identity project as a kind dotnet entry. That entry broke the Kotlin baseline gates that read this file: the Gradle roster check in gradle/policy/mobile-policy.gradle.kts (Apache project boundary roster differs from its canonical inventory) and the Android licence closure in eng/licences.py (Incomplete effective Gradle declarations), so verifyAndroidLicences and CodeQL failed on the hosted runners. This successor restores eng/policy/licence-boundary.json to its main bytes (sha256 eae6bb06..., the value recorded by gov-12-mobile-r6.json), so the Gradle roster is the baseline again. The .NET identity project is classified in eng/policy/dotnet-licence-boundary.json, which eng/licences.py project_audit audits through dotnet_audit for the csproj Apache-2.0 declarations, and eng/maui_identity.py check_licence_registration checks that registration. Against sourceCommit 377fa5d6, the only dependency input checked by eng/dependency_policy.py that differs is eng/policy/licence-boundary.json, which is now byte-identical to main; no Gradle dependency, version, lock, verification metadata, wrapper, JDK pin, workflow, Gradle policy or Kotlin source changed. The .NET inputs (global.json, Directory.Build.props, Directory.Packages.props, NuGet.config, .gitignore, src/ArcForges.Mobile/packages.lock.json, eng/policy/nuget-admission.json, eng/policy/dotnet-toolchain.json, eng/policy/workload-admission.json) remain admitted by their own records checked by eng/maui_identity.py, as r2 states. The first-party .NET Contracts client is ArcForges.Contracts.PublicApi 1.0.0-ci.324.1 with its transitive Foundation package, published from Contracts main 330e46bd, unchanged from r2; 1.0.0-ci.350.1 is not admitted. The Gradle/Kotlin baseline stays the frozen release channel until AND.40. r1 and r2 stay immutable history; their statements about eng/policy/licence-boundary.json are superseded here.
